record.question: While preparing detailed statement showing distribution of grants, the following points should be noted by the budget authorities. Which one of these is inappropriate?
options: The statement should show the distribution of the final allotments by the budget controlling officers in consultation the respective finance officers of the Zones/Divisions
The statement should contain an abstract of the charges by the prescribed sub-major heads
Specific allotment should be made for each individual major work
The amounts and details of the allotment/ceilings intimated in the Ministry should be strictly adhered to and on no account altered / breached
